project.title: [Company] — Grow Website Build
project.summary: Clinic website on the Grow package, adding AI CRM and automations for lead management, patient communication, and growth workflows.
objectives: AI CRM with pipeline, contacts, and follow-up automation
AI Automations for lead capture, nurture, and reactivation
Online booking and patient communication workflows

included: Website design and build (Grow package scope)
AI CRM setup: pipeline stages, contact fields, automation rules
AI Automations: lead capture forms, SMS/email nurture sequences, appointment reminders, lead reactivation workflows
exclusions: Content copywriting beyond the agreed page set
Ongoing changes after go-live (Web Care is separate and optional)
Custom functionality beyond Grow package scope
AI message credits beyond included allowance

timeline.notes: Estimated; final schedule confirmed at agreement

vat.note: VAT status is unresolved; no tax determination is made in this proposal.

client_responsibilities: Timely feedback on content, design, and CRM/automation review stages
Required copy, imagery, and CRM field requirements before build stage
Approval of automation workflows and message templates before activation
assumptions: Approved Final Project Price is the contractual commercial basis, not the public From price
No third-party costs are included without prior approval
AI message credits are subject to fair usage within included allowance
next_steps: Following acceptance, a commercial agreement is executed before invoicing
